limits: No performance improvement claim from single allocation samples.
HTTP fixture includes server and consumer allocations; it does not execute provider SSE parsers or physical terminal rendering.
Session fixture uses the real agent/session observer with an interactive stub; full renderer invariants are covered by the test suite, not this allocation measurement.
Retained references are explicitly checked for normal HTTP close and MCP normal/forced exit; broken-body and pre-cancelled HTTP are behavior tests, not separate retained-heap profiles.
No object pool, retry, fallback, provider SDK update, or application production source change.

validation.initialFailure: Old and candidate lockfiles both exposed SDK configured transport not forwarded; separately fixed in PR #176. Full current Node26 suite passes with this prerequisite.
